## Get FASTQ Files for GEO samples

```{bash}
n_geo_samples=$(grep -v geo_id misc/validation_geo_metadata.txt | wc -l)

n_geo_samples=$((n_geo_samples - 1))

sbatch --array=0-${n_geo_samples}%10 sbatchCmds/get_geo_fastqs.sh
```

```{bash get_data_count_geo}
n_samples=($( \
    cut -f 3,8 misc/validation_geo_metadata.txt \
    | uniq \
    | grep -v sample_id \
    | wc -l \
))

# since the array will start at zero
n_samples=$((n_samples - 1))

sbatch --array=0-${n_samples} sbatchCmds/count_geo.sh
```
